source-markup.purpose: Define the canonical Compass source-file markup contract for authored code in `apps/`, `packages/`, and `services/`. This document specifies the two required blocks, the inline invariant format, the forbidden set, and the two coverage modes.

block.name: MODULE_CONTRACT
block.purpose: State what the file is for and what it must NOT do.

inner.name: purpose
inner.rule: One or more sentences, at least 10 words.

inner.name: non-goals
inner.rule:
At least one `
` stating a boundary against scope creep.

block.name: CHANGE_SUMMARY
block.purpose: Capture the latest COMPASS-relevant change to the file.

inner.name: item
inner.rule:
At least one `
` describing the most recent COMPASS-relevant change.

rules.rule: Required for files with risk class `high` (blast-radius boundaries such as middleware, discovery/runtime cores, registries).
Keep invariants short, durable, and directly relevant to failure prevention.
Optional for non-high-risk files but encouraged when a non-obvious constraint exists.

forbidden.name: MODULE_MAP
forbidden.reason: Restates export names already visible in the code.

forbidden.name: responsibilities
forbidden.reason: Restates what the code does; purpose + non-goals carry the non-derivable signal.

forbidden.name: COMPASS_BLOCK
forbidden.reason: No downstream consumer; presence is a validation error.

applies-to.item: Every authored, non-excluded source file in `apps/`, `packages/`, and `services/`.

requirements.item:
`MODULE_CONTRACT` with `` (>= 10 words) and at least one `
`.
`CHANGE_SUMMARY` with at least one `
`.
`@ai-invariant` when the file's risk class is `high`.

applies-to.item: Explicitly excluded generated artifacts tracked by Compass inventory
Template files under `src/templates/**` that exist solely as generation inputs

astro-handling.rule: For `.astro` files, the two blocks and any `@ai-invariant` live inside the frontmatter (after the opening `---`), using `/* */` comment style.

rules.rule: New non-trivial files in `apps/`, `packages/`, and `services/` must follow this contract immediately.
Do not bulk-edit excluded or generated files to add semantic markup.

For package generators that emit boilerplate into `apps/*`, place multi-line boilerplate in mirrored template files under `src/templates/**` and keep the authored generator module as the COMPASS-covered source of logic.
